'''Jayke Ball Myoom onith the Emporers Hand''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jayke Ball]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10831">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10831 Myoom onith  the Emporers Hand], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 1 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10831/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10831/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018112706/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10831/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jayke Ball]]
* '''Published:''' 1 October 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Myoom onith  the Emporers Hand''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 BHBM Ball DS 2000 10831.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Deny the opponent all force generation. Use docking bays to give you LOTS of force due to mobilzation points. Use myoom onith to kill off all unigue Males. Then use monnok to kill doubles. Then just force drain and battle whats left.

== Original post ==

'''Myoom onith  the Emporers Hand'''
* '''Author:''' Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball
* '''Published:''' October 1, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' Deny the opponent all force generation. Use docking bays to give you LOTS of force due to mobilzation points. Use myoom onith to kill off all unigue Males. Then use monnok to kill doubles. Then just force drain and battle whats left.

=== Strategy ===

Bassically liek I said before, you generate at least 20 force by your second turn, while your opponent only get what they activate. I forgot to add that I start with Rendilli in my hand from moblization points. They wont draw too many cards, and you will have plenty of force for myoom onith.  Use her and Kill off all the unique males, then Monnok and doubles that are left. Then If they manage to get out lea or some non-uniques, kill them off with vader and tarkin or whoever. Then get vader to a battle ground so they lose 3 force. you should be able to keep luke in their lost pile with myoom onith, but if they get him out either go get him or let him be. He can't do much good without and backup (even jedi luke can't fight off too many charactors by himself)  PLease review this deck, I am going to a tournie soon and could really use a good review. Thanks
